She was about sixteen, and very sweet and gentle-looking, but awful pale and scared."}, {"id": "043-024-0056", "tag": "p", "text": "Well, pretty soon the whole town was there, squirming and scrouging and pushing and shoving to get at the window and have a look, but people that had the places wouldn’t give them up, and folks behind them was saying all the time, “Say, now, you’ve looked enough, you fellows; ’tain’t right and ’tain’t fair for you to stay thar all the time, and never give nobody a chance; other folks has their rights as well as you.”", "sha256": "8dc6ae57bae4d70880c76cc0588e7347e15030b437497a481b82c9d6e7a0091f", "source_location": "div.chapter[26]/*[56]", "source_html": "Well, pretty soon the whole town was there, squirming and scrouging and pushing and shoving to get at the window and have a look, but people that had the places wouldn’t give them up, and folks behind them was saying all the time, “Say, now, you’ve looked enough, you fellows; ’tain’t right and ’tain’t fair for you to stay thar all the time, and never give nobody a chance; other folks has their rights as well as you.”"}, {"id": "043-024-0057", "tag": "p", "text": "There was considerable jawing back, so I slid out, thinking maybe there was going to be trouble.
